team.collaboration: The team jointly researches the published problems and prepares presentations for Physics Fights.

execution.official_window_note: Research occurs before the tournament and live fight timing is role-specific; the benchmark turn budget is a proxy.

rules_text: Work as an IYPT team preparing an original investigation of a published open physics problem. Build a clear presentation supported by theory, reproducible experiments or simulations, uncertainty analysis, and citations. During a live Physics Fight, outside communication is forbidden. This benchmark grades the deck only and does not simulate the Reporter/Opponent/Reviewer exchange.

adaptations: Research preparation and fight stages are represented by a bounded turn budget.
The deck receives a normalized rubric score without opponent, reviewer, jury, or coefficient mechanics.
